meta.description: Personal portfolio of Prionto Hira Deep — Computer Science & Engineering student, competitive programmer, robotics enthusiast, and visual storyteller based in Chittagong, Bangladesh.

identity.name: Prionto Hira Deep
identity.bio: I'm a Computer Science & Engineering student at CUET with a deep passion for algorithms, embedded systems, and visual storytelling. I solve problems on Codeforces, build robots that actually move, and photograph light the way a compiler reads source — precisely.
identity.bioHighlight: algorithms, embedded systems, and visual storytelling

projects.title: Graph Pathfinder Visualizer
projects.description: An interactive browser-based visualizer for BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, and A* on configurable weighted grids. Step-through mode lets you watch the frontier expand in real time.

projects.title: Autonomous Line-Following Robot
projects.description: A 4-wheel differential-drive robot with PID-tuned IR sensor array for competitive maze navigation. Achieved sub-3-second lap times on a 2m×2m track at inter-university contest.

projects.title: CP Template Library
projects.description: A battle-tested competitive programming template library with 80+ implementations — Fenwick trees, sparse tables, modular arithmetic, geometry primitives — all tested against Codeforces judges.
projects.thumbnailAlt: Code editor with CP library code

projects.title: Chittagong Light — Street Photography Series
projects.description: A 40-image documentary series capturing the morning ferry ghats, rickshaw pullers at golden hour, and monsoon flooding on the streets of Chittagong. Shot on mirrorless, edited in Lightroom.
projects.thumbnailAlt: Ferry ghat at golden hour, Chittagong
highlights: Featured in CUET Photography Club exhibit

projects.title: Smart Room IoT Dashboard
projects.description: ESP32-based room automation system with temperature, humidity, and PIR motion sensing. Real-time MQTT data stream visualized on a self-hosted Node-RED dashboard over local Wi-Fi.
projects.thumbnailAlt: IoT dashboard showing room sensor data

projects.title: Long Exposure Night Sky — Shyamnagar Series
projects.description: Long-exposure astrophotography from Shyamnagar's Sundarbans buffer zone. 18 images capturing star trails and Milky Way arcs with a 25-minute composite technique.
projects.thumbnailAlt: Star trails over the Sundarbans buffer zone

projects.title: Mini Compiler — Subset C to x86
projects.description: Academic compiler project implementing a full lexer → parser → semantic analyzer → x86 code generator pipeline for a subset of C. Supports if/else, while loops, functions, and arrays.

projects.title: Delta Robot — 3-DOF Pick & Place
projects.description: A 3-DOF parallel delta robot with inverse kinematics solver running on Raspberry Pi 4. Capable of high-speed pick-and-place operations at 2 cycles/second. Full CAD model in Fusion 360.

ideas.title: Distributed Sudoku Solver over WebSockets
ideas.description: Shard a constraint propagation Sudoku solver across N browser tabs using BroadcastChannel API — no server, pure client-side distributed computing demo.
ideas.inspiration: After reading the Dancing Links paper — wanted to see if web tabs could act as worker nodes.

ideas.title: Haptic Braille Reader — Solenoid Array
ideas.description: A 4×2 solenoid matrix driven by an ESP32 that converts BMP text images into refreshable Braille cells for a low-cost assistive device.
ideas.inspiration: Observed visually impaired students at CUET using expensive commercial readers.

ideas.title: Algorithmic Composition Engine
ideas.description: Generate non-repetitive lo-fi beats using Markov chains trained on CC0 MIDI datasets, rendered in-browser with the Web Audio API — no ML framework needed.
ideas.inspiration: Realized most lo-fi generators are just YouTube streams — wanted something actually generative.

ideas.title: Open Hardware Air Quality Monitor
ideas.description: PM2.5 + CO2 + VOC sensor node built on a custom KiCad PCB with an E-ink display and LoRa uplink for mesh coverage across a university campus.
ideas.inspiration: Air quality data around CUET campus is essentially non-existent.

ideas.title: Photogrammetry Pipeline for Sundarbans Topology
ideas.description: Use drone photogrammetry (OpenDroneMap) to build centimeter-accuracy DEMs of Sundarban riverine erosion zones — open data for climate researchers.
ideas.inspiration: Saw a tidal erosion timelapse and realized nobody has open topographic data for this area.

timeline.title: Codeforces — newbie
timeline.description: Reached newbie rank (rated 800+) after consistent contest participation. Solved 100+ problems across Codeforces, Atcoder, and CSES problem sets.

timeline.title: National Inter-College Science Fair — 2nd Place
timeline.description: Created an electron powered air-cooler. It was featured in a science fair and won 2nd place against 50+ college teams.

timeline.title: National Level Talent Searching Competition - 1st Place
timeline.description: Placed first in the whole district and became a participant in the national level competition.

timeline.title: B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering
timeline.description: Studying data structures, algorithms, computer architecture, operating systems, computer networks, digital electronics, and embedded systems. Active member of CUET Programming Club and Robotics Club.

timeline.title: Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC)
timeline.description: Science group. GPA 5.00/5.00. Science Olympiad participant at district level. Built first Arduino project — an automated plant watering system.

timeline.title: Secondary School Certificate (SSC)
timeline.description: Science group. GPA 5.00/5.00. Mathematics Olympiad participant, division winner at Khulna zone. Got first exposure to programming through Logo and Pascal.
